subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Is the reporter's latest evidence enough to accept another fix PR, or should maintainers require a live current-main scheduled-heartbeat repro first?
rationale: Current source and shipped tests already cover the obvious stale-runtime explicit-agent path, while the new evidence may be confounded by an untargeted manual event path documented to wake main.

options.title: Require live scheduled-heartbeat repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but block new fix PRs until a current-main Docker run proves scheduled historian2 heartbeat writes to main without relying on untargeted `system event`.

options.title: Accept a source-only fix attempt
options.body: Allow a narrow PR based on source inspection, accepting the risk of another duplicate or wrong-entry-point heartbeat routing patch.

recommendation.title: Require live scheduled-heartbeat repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but block new fix PRs until a current-main Docker run proves scheduled historian2 heartbeat writes to main without relying on untargeted `system event`.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped related cron agent fix and have the strongest current routing/proof ownership signal in the reviewed history.
